prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: high-quality transparent floral decoration for a moody, romantic navy-blue wedding invitation.
Primary request: an elegant organic cluster of deep NAVY BLUE roses, with three generously layered open blooms in varied sizes, a few small rosebuds, slender curving stems and softly tapering foliage. Navy blue must be the dominant flower color: midnight ink-blue and deep blue-gray petals with restrained smoky slate-blue highlights so the intricate petal folds remain readable. Leaves are muted deep olive and desaturated blue-green. Keep the composition airy and naturally asymmetric, with stems and leaves extending gracefully around the blooms, suitable as a small decorative floral accent.
Style: refined vintage botanical painting with realistic flower anatomy, velvety petals, subtle hand-painted texture and soft natural shading. Luxurious, intimate and romantic, with carefully preserved fine edges. Avoid a flat icon or cartoon look.
Composition: one cohesive isolated floral arrangement, comfortably framed with a clear margin around every leaf and petal; portrait canvas approximately 4:5. Show the entire arrangement, no cropped blooms or clipped foliage. No typography space needs to be built into the artwork.
Background: genuinely transparent outside the flowers, leaves and stems. No dark square, cream paper, checkerboard pattern, background scene, vignette or ground shadow.
Constraints: no white, pink, purple, burgundy, royal-blue or bright cyan flowers; no metallic flowers or gold glitter; no vase, bow, ribbon, border, frame, text, logo, watermark or extra objects. Only the navy floral arrangement on transparency.
authorization: User explicitly requested navy-blue romantic moody flowers for decoration.
use: Prepared floral decoration asset for Jahzen and Glyzell; section placement has not been assigned.
